name: Golden Pistol (Simple)
author: wolfsdk
description: Makes the standard pistol (campaign and DLC 'Agent Silent Death') golden, using material decls only: loosealbedo to black, loosespec to specular/gold, loosesmoothness to high gloss. Exactly the recipe retail uses to make textures/pickups/gold gold. All images used are in gameresources.resources (always loaded). Covers the body, silencer, both magazines, bullets, pickup and the blood variants. Do not enable together with 'Golden Pistol': this mod swaps the materials and hides its textures. Structurally valid, not yet confirmed in game.
